prompt:
Elephants at the Dust Bath,  Mosaic

A playful elephant family tossing fine dust over themselves beneath bright afternoon sunlight, viewed from behind a tiny foreground wildflower so the elephants feel enormous in the distance. Hand-cut mosaic tiles, irregular stone pieces, sparkling ceramic surfaces and warm earth-and-sky colors.

translations.zh: 尘浴中的大象，马赛克风格。在明媚午后阳光下，嬉戏的象群往身上扬起细尘，从前景微小的野花后方视角观察，令远处的大象显得格外庞大。手工切割马赛克瓷砖、不规则石块、微闪的陶瓷表面以及温暖的大地与天空色调。
